_comment: Applied by vm/metabase_content.py (D109). Times are relative to the latest day in the data, not today.
name: Players and tournaments
description: Members and competition: sign-ups, who plays where, who holds the high scores, and the tournaments.

cards.name: Member sign-ups per month, 24 months
cards.description: New member cards per month over the last 24 months, by the venue they signed up at.
sql: WITH l AS (SELECT max(day) AS d FROM annex_api.daily_plays)
SELECT date_trunc('month', m.member_since)::date AS month, m.home_venue_code AS venue, count(*) AS sign_ups

cards.name: Active members per venue, 30 days
cards.description: Members whose last game was in the 30 days up to the latest day in the data, by home venue (where they signed up).
sql: WITH l AS (SELECT max(day) AS d FROM annex_api.daily_plays)
SELECT m.home_venue_code AS venue, count(*) AS active_members
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY active_members DESC

cards.name: Most leaderboard spots
cards.description: The 15 members in the most all-time top-10 tables, with their best place and rating.
sql: SELECT m.nickname, m.handle, m.home_venue_code AS home_venue, m.leaderboard_spots, m.best_rank, m.rating, m.venues_played
ORDER BY m.leaderboard_spots DESC, m.best_rank, m.rating DESC

cards.name: Tournament entries over time
cards.description: Players entered per tournament against the places, including the upcoming one still taking registrations.
sql: SELECT t.starts_on, t.name || CASE WHEN t.status = 'registration' THEN ' (upcoming)' ELSE '' END AS tournament,

cards.name: The last tournament's standings
cards.description: Final standings of the most recent completed tournament.
sql: SELECT s.position, s.nickname, s.handle, s.points, s.games_played, s.best_score, s.tournament_name AS tournament, s.starts_on
WHERE s.tournament_id = (SELECT t.tournament_id FROM annex_api.tournaments t WHERE t.status = 'completed'
